quests.title: A Parcel for Sark
quests.giver: a resident of St Peter Port
quests.summary: Carry a brown-paper parcel to a relative in Sark, then bring word back to St Peter Port.

steps.line: Oh, from St Peter Port? That'll be my sister's doing. A cardigan, again. Tell her I'm wearing the last one.

steps.text: Take the word back to St Peter Port.
steps.line: Oh, you've been! And she's wearing it? Well. That's me told, and a tea owed to you.

start.ask: Well, would you do me a kindness? There's a parcel here for my sister in Sark. It's only a cardigan and a lot of string.
start.accept: Marvellous. Mind the string, it's load-bearing.
